title: Section 1 — Description and history
description: Signature Social is a mirror of the social kind of website: a website where people share short posts, follow each other, and comment. Social websites began as plain lists of messages in time order, then grew follow lists, like counts, comment threads, and feeds ranked by score. This mirror follows the same shape — posts, a feed, and comments counted — rebuilt with Signature branding and the network's own data.

title: Section 3 — Science proof
description: The science behind this mirror is the social feed: posts, counts, and ranking. A social website takes short messages from people, counts the likes and comments each one draws, and ranks the feed so the liveliest posts sit near the top. This mirror does that work in miniature: eight sample posts with fixed counts, a score rule from Section 2, and a feed that lists your new post first and the sample posts by score.

title: Section 5 — Spec / patent + 3D-print version
description: Spec. The Signature spec for this mirror is a draft specification for a local feed over a fixed sample set: the post format (author, text, likes, comments), the score rule from Section 2, the feed-order rule, and the no-account, no-sharing, no-tracking design. The spec is a draft — ready to file, not filed, not a granted patent.

title: Section 6 — Demonstration programs / working prototypes
description: The demonstration on this page is the local feed. Type a short message — for example, 'Hello from the market' — and press the button. The page checks the message is not empty and is 140 characters or fewer, then puts it at the top of the feed, beside the mirror's own sample posts ranked by score.

title: Section 7 — Two AIs
description: The website AI of this mirror. It discusses the mirror, helps you read the feed in the field, explains why any post ranks where it does, and routes detailed questions to the website or database AI that owns the subject. It speaks in natural sentences and never presents a sample post as a real person's post.

title: Section 8 — USE section — use, download, copy
description: Use it: use the local feed at the top of this page. Type a short message, press the button, and see it at the top of the feed.

title: Section 9 — Sources, codes, and network
description: Sources. The mirror's sample posts are the network's own data, made for this mirror. The score rule is the mirror's own rule, stated in full in Section 2. Feed ranking — posts, counts, and order — is a general concept of the social kind of website, described here in general terms; no outside source is quoted as the mirror's own method.

title: 1. The Signature Social website AI
description: The website AI of this mirror. title: 2. The AI version of the social
description: An AI version of the social service itself. It takes a short message in plain words, posts it to the local feed, and talks about the feed from the mirror's own sample posts. It shares nothing outside the page, and it says so.

description: Type a short message — 140 characters or fewer — and press the button. It joins the top of the feed below, beside the mirror's own sample posts. The feed lives only in this page: nothing is shared anywhere, and no sample post is from a real person.
